title: Cotton Floral Printed Top & Wide Leg Palazzo Co-ord Set
description:
Chandrika means “moonlight” – soft cream florals with a gentle glow.

Ivory cream cotton floral printed top and palazzo set featuring a sleeveless V-neck peplum top with delicate white lace detailing and a flared hem. The top has mustard brown, olive green and turquoise floral prints, paired with light cream wide-leg palazzo pants. A comfortable two-piece outfit for everyday wear, casual outings and vacations.

✦ The Details
• Sleeveless V-neck peplum top with white lace trim and a flared hem
• Mustard brown, olive green and turquoise florals on ivory cream cotton
• Light cream wide-leg palazzo pants for an easy, matching look
• Two pieces: top and palazzo, top length about 28 inches

✦ How to Wear It
Wear the set together with flat sandals for college, office or a holiday, or split it up: the top over blue jeans, the palazzo with a plain white tee. A tan sling bag and small gold studs pick up the mustard in the print.

✦ Fit, Size & Care
A relaxed fit, so take your usual size. Sizes XS–3XL, or free custom fit to your measurements. Gentle hand wash in cold water, wash separately, do not bleach and dry in shade.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water. Wash separately, do not bleach and dry in shade.
